rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is inadequate or below expectations.

example.english: The result of this renovation is unsatisfactory.
example.traditional: 今次裝修個效果唔理想。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zong1 sau1 go3 haau6 gwo2 m4 lei5 soeng2

rows.note: Use this casual choice when saying that something simply is not good enough or does not work.

example.english: This coffee machine keeps leaking; it is really unsatisfactory.
example.traditional: 呢部咖啡機成日漏水，真係唔掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gaa3 fe1 gei1 seng4 jat6 lau6 seoi2 zan1 hai6 m4 dim6

rows.note: Use this when the thing fails a stated standard, requirement, or quality threshold.

example.english: This batch of toys fails the safety test and is unsatisfactory.
example.traditional: 呢批玩具未通過安全測試，屬於唔合格。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 wun6 geoi6 mei6 tung1 gwo3 on1 cyun4 cak1 si3 suk6 jyu1 m4 hap6 gaak3
